title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Workforce Insights agent for leaders, managers and delegates
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing requirements and documented controls are supported. Minor corrections should complete the access-policy route and reconcile checklist settings with the controls table; no blocking finding was established.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Learn documents the agent as part of Microsoft Frontier and subject to change.
claims.quote: The Workforce Insights agent is in the Microsoft Frontier program and subject to change.

claims.claim: The documented agent summarizes workforce-planning guidance based on skills.
claims.quote: Perform and summarize guidance and best practices for workforce planning based on skills.

claims.claim: The documented agent identifies skills and finds team members by attributes such as level, location and title.
claims.quote:
Identify skills and suggest improvements to organizational structure.
- Find team members in your organization and filter by attributes such as level, location, title, etc.

claims.claim: The agent uses organizational data about employees.
claims.quote:
The Workforce Insights agent uses information from:
- Organizational Data
    - Organizational data describes the users in your organization.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The agent uses custom attributes explicitly made available to it.
claims.quote: These attributes need to be explicitly uploaded and made available to the Workforce Insights service.

claims.claim: The agent can use People Skills data.
claims.quote: The Workforce Insights Agent can use the People Skills data that's available in your organization.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Responses depend on the user's role and configured data-access policies.
claims.quote: You can only search for information that's available to you about your team. Responses are based on your role, and policies set by your admin and organization.

claims.claim: Administrators can configure attribute descriptions.
claims.quote:
Under Attribute descriptions, select Manage descriptions.
4. Enter an attribute and its description.

claims.claim: Administrators can configure organization context.
claims.quote: Org context lets admins add definitions and guidance. The agent uses it to learn your terms and business rules when it answers.

claims.claim: Administrators can configure organization-specific prompts.
claims.quote: Org-specific prompts are ready-made prompts that admins add to the agent.

claims.claim: Administrators can configure a custom AI disclaimer.
claims.quote: Use a custom AI disclaimer to show your company's guidance in the agent.

claims.claim: The documented settings can be managed through settings pages or guided chat, which saves changes only after confirmation.
claims.quote:
You can switch between chat and the settings pages at any time. Both update the same settings.
The agent saves a change only after you confirm it.

claims.claim: Administrators can add up to six organization-specific prompts per tenant.
claims.quote: Administrators can create up to six organization-specific prompts per tenant.

claims.claim: Organization-specific prompts apply tenant-wide rather than to selected groups or roles.
claims.quote: Your prompts apply to the whole company and aren't aimed at certain groups or roles.

claims.claim: A custom SupervisorIndicator attribute can override manager identification for insights.
claims.quote: you can override the default logic by providing a SupervisorIndicator as custom attribute in your organizational data.

claims.quote: Use the Organizational Data Source Administrator to import and maintain data.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Delegates require a paid Microsoft Copilot license.
claims.quote: Delegates also require a paid Microsoft Copilot license.

claims.claim: Allow users to delegate access determines whether delegates receive the delegator's population scope for attributes under that policy.
claims.quote: When disabled, the user can still assign a delegate in Workforce Insights, but the delegate won't have access to the user's population scope for attributes where delegation is not enabled in the policy.

claims.claim: The documentation describes no autonomous action on employee data.
claims.quote: Searched: Workforce Insights agent autonomous actions employee data audit usage reports. Opened workforce-insights-agent, overview-wfi-agent and configure-workforce-insights-agent; these describe queries and confirmed configuration changes, not autonomous employee-data actions.

claims.claim: The Frontier admin, delegation and report experiences are limited to English.
claims.quote: Features like the landing page and chat work in all Microsoft Copilot languages but experiences like delegation, reports, and admin experiences are limited to English.

claims.claim: SupervisorIndicator and WeeklyBadgeDays stopped being sent as reserved fields starting October 1, 2026.
claims.quote: Starting October 1, 2026, SupervisorIndicator and WeeklyBadgeDays are no longer sent to Workforce Insights Agent (Frontier) as reserved fields.

claims.claim: Existing customers using those reserved fields must copy them to renamed custom fields mapped to Microsoft 365 Profile.
claims.quote: Current customers who use these fields: Copy each field and give it a new name, like SupervisorIndicator2 or WeeklyBadgeDays2. Map it to Microsoft 365 Profile as a custom field. Use the new field in Workforce Insights.

claims.claim: Organization context changes can take up to 15 minutes to take effect.
claims.quote: Changes can take up to 15 minutes to take effect.

claims.claim: deployedTo and acquireUsersAndGroups set the deployment scope.
claims.quote: deployedTo | packageAcquireStatus | Enum value indicating the deployment scope of the package. Required if updating acquireUsersAndGroups.

claims.claim: availableTo and allowedUsersAndGroups set availability.
claims.quote: availableTo | packageAllowStatus | Enum value specifying which users or groups within the tenant can access this package. Required if updating allowedUsersAndGroups.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft 365 admin-center route reaches the organizational-data access-policy configuration page.
